prompts.A: Use case: illustration-story. Create an original square 1:1 Project Zomboid mod Workshop cover, legible at 256 px. First reference is the definitive character design for SuQing: match the same face, silver-white long hair, light lilac eyes, pair of pale curved dragon horns, pale lavender dragon wings and long white scaled dragon tail. Second reference is only series style and title layout: use that finely textured high-quality anime illustration, white/lavender palette, intricate pixel-art influenced rendering, and a dark purple embroidered title panel across the lower quarter with generous padding. Keep the central visual distinct and immediately readable as a nonliving homemade training dummy: straw-stuffed tan burlap human torso and head, burgundy concentric target stitched on chest, rope wrapped shoulders, brown horizontal wooden crossbar and upright stake planted into a crossed wooden base. Retain SuQing's white-purple cloth, rose accessory, stitched floral motifs. No blue fairy needed. Show exactly this title in prominent two-line Chinese within the panel: "蘇清的" then "训练假人". Smaller English exact label "SuQing's Training Dummy" underneath. No other text, watermarks, version or brand logos. Keep face, dummy head, target and action clear above the panel. A pre-dusk fortified survivor backyard with a weathered timber fence, overgrown ivy and a warm lantern. SuQing on left practicing a controlled horizontal baseball bat strike into the dummy on right. Animated diagonal composition with the bat contacting clearly visible burlap torso, a tiny tuft of escaping straw, hair and white cloth moving. Warm amber sunlight contrasted with pale lavender.
